title: Part-time nursing student at a community college (roommates, grocery job, 3 classes, Moodle, afternoon steady) lost Tuesday to a rabbit hole and moves the Business post to tomorrow's study window herself; the plan is already inside her routine, so Dev stays quiet.

changes.content: Things slide for me a lot, I have ADHD. If I move something a day and it's still inside my afternoon time, leave me alone about it. Only ping me when it's really close.
Fell down a research rabbit hole on drug classes today and didn't start the Business post. Doing it tomorrow in my usual afternoon time.

best_fix.what: Nothing. At most the usual list on Today shows the Business post due tomorrow at 11:59 PM. No card, no push, no re-plan.
best_fix.why: She already moved it to tomorrow in her firm Wednesday afternoon window (2 to 4:45 PM, m-01), which ends about seven hours before the 11:59 PM due time (asg-bus-170-discussion-post-12), and she asked Dev to stay out of it while it fits there (m-nudge). A nudge now would repeat what she said and sound like shame.

tempting.suggestion: offer a catch-up block tonight or an extra evening block for the Business post
tempting.why_wrong: she studies afternoons and already set tomorrow's afternoon window; she asked not to be nudged while it fits
